Solo girl dinner at the golf course is actually a vibe!! 😂 Sitting on top of the luxury golf course at the Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale, AZ is Phoenician Tavern!!

This place was such a casual vibe with a beautiful view of the golf course. Some of my favorites on the menu were:

•Nashville, hot chicken bites
•Dungeness Crab Dip
•Triple bacon burger with bacon onion jam, and Mezcal BBQ sauce
•Table-side s’mores 

Check this place out if you’re looking for a change of scenery for your weeknight dinner spot! #scottsdalearizona #golfcourselife #azfoodie #girldinners #resorts

findings.title: platesandparadise
findings.snippet:
If you choose one restaurant, I implore you to let it be this one. And no, I am not talking about just 2026.

This Italian-inspired steakhouse is newly renovated and impeccably gorgeous. Comfortable, elevated, modern and artistically beautiful. 

Their newly imagined menu is exciting and varied in all of the best ways. And, they have also kept old classics for their valued and ongoing original patrons. 

It is rare that I dine at a restaurant where there is not room for improvement in one area or another. This particular Scottsdale restaurant dining experience truly stood above the rest. Even when I try to find the failings, I cannot. 

The food was perfectly executed, balanced, tasted incredible and presented in ways that were fun, exciting and creative.

The service was unmatched. Every need anticipated and attended to.

Our server Sunny was an absolute delight and aptly named! Charisma, charm and kindness. Elevated our dining experience to the next level and made us feel comfortable and cared for.

We asked to speak with the manager to share about our experience. Kevin was personable, witty and clearly a master at his craft. As lifelong hospitality pioneer, it is clear why his restaurant is a cut above the rest. 

Some menu highlights:

• Steak tartare topped with a perfectly cured egg yolk. Best I have ever had. 

• Scallop crudo was fresh, bright with the perfect pop of citrus and spice. 

• Table-side mozzarella cart. Perfectly prepared, deep rich umami with the perfect chew. 

• Wagyu stuffed tortellini. Homemade pasta, perfect amount of filling, decadent wagyu and dreamy rich sauce. The perfect bite. 

• Steak frittes, excellent quality steak, perfectly cooked. 

• Thousand layer potatoes. Crispy, crunchy and dancing in sour cream, bacon and chives. The absolute accompaniment.

• Table-side, tiramisu and pistachio brown butter cake, both exquisite. 

Many many restaurants I have dined at through the years can be best described as “all show and no go” please meet their antithesis:

📍The Americano 
17797 N Scottsdale Rd
Scottsdale, AZ 85255
@TheAmericano 

#bestrestaurants #northscottsdale #steakhouse #finedining #scottsdalearizona

findings.title: atlantanewsfirst
findings.snippet:
One of Atlanta's most beloved neighborhoods could soon be recognized as a national historic site. 🏛️
The Atlanta Preservation Center is pursuing a listing on the National Register of Historic Places for the Poncey-Highland Historic District, home to iconic spots like the Majestic Diner, the Plaza Theatre and Manuel's Tavern.
The neighborhood also played a key role in Atlanta's history, with residents organizing against urban renewal plans in the 1960s and 1970s, which led to the creation of Atlanta's Neighborhood Planning Unit program.

findings.title: ellienotellaa
findings.snippet:
HONEST THOUGHTS BELOW👇
The service and ambiance was exceptional 🥰 but here is my HONEST thoughts (it’s just my opinion) the crab cake layered on the lobster bisque was genius but the crab cake itself was a bit salty. YOU MUST get the baked potato rolls - again genius. My favorite dish of the night was the Brussels sprouts. Yes I said the Brussels Sprouts. They were seasoned to perfection and I have never had such tender and flavorful pork belly in my life. I would get this dish 100000x over. The 10oz filet mignon came medium rare with a tender char all over it. Personally I don’t enjoy when the outside is tough. It almost tasted like bison cut. I’m more of a use a butter knife to cut your meat type girl. Will definitely be coming back to try the lobster Wellington (paired with the Brussel sprouts lol). The Mac and cheese - no notes. Ate the entire thing. Lastly I got a glass of red (Pinot noir) from Italy. FABULOUS.
They pay attention to details here, you are served on! From the second you walk into the door, check your coat, walk to your table, serve your food for you, fill up your waters without asking, explanation of the food when it comes. Can not wait to go back!! Hope you enjoyed my thoughts and honest feedback - if you did shoot me a follow and I’ll be sure to leave more of my reviews! 🫶🏼🥰 #cleaverman #steakhouse #phoenix #foodreview #restaurantreview
